texts.8c2af426828b: Primary objective: To assess the safety in myocardial infarction of therapy with the thrombolytic anistreplase, administed in general practise. Secondary objective: To asses the feasibility of the use of anistreplase in primar care. Two comparison groups of patients will be recruited; those who clinically have had a myocardial infarction and who were given anistreplase, and those who clinically have had infarction but who did not recieve the thrombolytic. The main study outcome will be event rates occuring in each group.
texts.ca420c58b7dd: The data supplied will be used only for the approved medical research project MR377 - RCGP MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION STUDY
texts.e494b451abe6: The data supplied by the NHS IC to University of Aberdeen will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project identified above.
